description: Screenshot of the headline area of an August 9, 2017 article by Patrick Lawrence (published by The Nation) titled 'A New Report Raises Big Questions About Last Year's DNC Hack'. The subhead states the article's claim that former NSA experts say the DNC breach was a leak by an insider, not a hack. Below is a photo of the Democratic National Headquarters building entrance at 430 South Capitol Street, credited Sipa via AP Images, dated October 27, 2016.
text: DEMOCRATIC NATIONAL COMMITTEE. HACKERS. TRUMP AND RUSSIA. A New Report Raises Big Questions About Last Year's DNC Hack. Former NSA experts say it wasn't a hack at all, but a leak—an inside job by someone with access to the DNC's system. By Patrick Lawrence. AUGUST 9, 2017. DEMOCRATIC NATIONAL HEADQUARTERS. 430 SOUTH CAPITOL STREET. The Democratic National Committee headquarters, October 27, 2016. (Sipa via AP Images)
flags: Article's central claim (leak not hack, per former NSA experts) is contested and was widely disputed; carried here as the article's claim.

description: Meme from The Patriot Post using a still of Jeff Bridges as 'The Dude' from the film The Big Lebowski. The caption claims Joe Biden blackmailed Ukraine with a billion dollars in tax money to drop an investigation into his son, and mocks Democrats for wanting to impeach President Trump for asking about it. Patriot Post logo and URL at the bottom.
text: LET ME GET THIS STRAIGHT... BIDEN BLACKMAILED UKRAINE WITH A BILLION IN TAX DOLLARS TO DROP AN INVESTIGATION INTO HIS SON, AND DEMOCRATS WANT TO IMPEACH PRESIDENT TRUMP SIMPLY FOR ASKING IF IT WAS TRUE? THE BEST COMMENTARY AND MEMES ARE AT THE PATRIOT POST - PATRIOTPOST.US
flags: Caption's claim that Biden blackmailed Ukraine to protect his son is disputed/misleading; carried as the meme's claim only.

description: Photograph of part of a California vote-by-mail ballot request form for voters not registered with a political party, for a March presidential primary. Three party ballot choices are listed — American Independent, Democratic, Libertarian — with '(select only one)' and a signature line marked with a red X. The right edge of the form text is cut off. Filename 'WelcomeToCali' frames it as commentary that the Republican ballot option is absent; in California only parties that permit crossover voting by no-party-preference voters appear on this form.
text: I am not currently registered with a political party. For the Marc[h]. I request a Vote By Mail ballot that includes the Presidential cont[est]. American Independent. Democratic. Libertarian. (select only one). Signature: X. (Must be signed by applicant to b[e...])
flags: Implied claim (Republicans excluded from California ballots) is misleading: the GOP did not allow crossover voting by unaffiliated voters, so it does not appear on this NPP form.
Right edge of document text cropped; bracketed completions inferred.

description: Screenshot of a December 17, 2019 tweet by user @lannymc (display name 'NS') with two photos of a Los Angeles County California vote-by-mail crossover-ballot mailer. The tweet claims the outside of the card offers no Republican choice while the inside does, calling it 'corrupt Calif govt' and tagging @TomFitton. The right photo actually shows the card's explanation: non-partisan voters can directly request American Independent, Democratic, or Libertarian ballots, but must change party affiliation to receive a Green, Peace & Freedom, or Republican ballot.

description: Photograph (rotated sideways) of a hand holding a Los Angeles County vote-by-mail crossover ballot request card for the March 3, 2020 Presidential Primary Election. Same mailer as shown in the related tweet claiming Republicans were excluded.
